import os
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "src"))
from wordfreq import top_words  # noqa: E402

SAMPLE = os.path.join(ROOT, "sample.txt")
SCRIPT = os.path.join(ROOT, "src", "wordfreq.py")


class TopWordsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sample_full(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            top_words(SAMPLE),
            [("the", 4), ("cat", 2), ("hat", 2), ("and", 1), ("fell", 1), ("sat", 1)],
        )

    def test_n_limits_results(self):
        self.assertEqual(top_words(SAMPLE, 2), [("the", 4), ("cat", 2)])

    def test_cli_default_n(self):
        out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SCRIPT, SAMPLE],
                             capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
        self.assertEqual(out.splitlines()[0], "the 4")
        self.assertEqual(len(out.splitlines()), 6)

    def test_cli_missing_path(self):
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SCRIPT], capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertNotEqual(r.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn("usage", r.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
